Hi Hailey❤️

Before anything else, I just want you to know — you make ordinary days feel special. The way you laugh, the way you care, the way you just are… I haven't stopped thinking about it.

I find myself looking forward to the hours when it's just us — no noise, no rush, just you and me together. Those are my favourite hours in the whole week.

And can we talk about how ridiculously multi-talented you are? Piano — the thing I've been dying to learn for the longest time, and you just glide across the keys like it's nothing 🎹. Swimming — you cut through the water like it was made for you, fast, graceful, unstoppable 🌊. Hockey, robotics… you'd probably make a brilliant lawyer too. Honestly, I'm still a little jealous — is there anything you can't do? 😄

I love how chill you are about everything — that calm, nonchalant energy that makes me feel like everything will be okay. You always know how to reassure me, even when I don't say a word. You just… get me.

And those eyes of yours — that whole ocean of eyes. One look and I'm drowning, happily, no lifeguard needed 🌊. I could gaze into them all day and still find new depths every time. Careful… a person could get lost in there forever.

Truthfully? I just love everything about you. Every little thing.

I made this tiny corner of the internet just for you. No distractions, no rush. Just you, me, and one very important question at the end.

— with all my love
